integrity: The seven-generator order and free-algebra universal property were checked directly against Moraschini's paper. The 37-element distributive lattice and its two lattice automorphisms were reconstructed independently from Fact 5.2 and exhaustively verified.
limitations: The result is specific to the one-generated free positive S4-algebra.
The full multiplication table of the 37-element endomorphism monoid is not classified here.
An unindexed folklore observation based on Figure 1 remains an originality risk.
No independent audit has been performed.
title: Modal operations destroy the sole lattice symmetry of the free positive S4 algebra
